objective: Add durable MongoDB workspace persistence and an immutable context edit ledger beneath the canonical ContextFabric working-context boundary without introducing a new authority or database.

rulesConsidered: MongoDB is the canonical distributed operational persistence boundary.
ContextFabric is the sole active working-context authority.
Durable persistence is infrastructure and cannot become policy, capability, economic, artifact, verification, or release authority.
Stale writers must fail closed rather than overwrite newer state.
No new database or parallel context authority is introduced.
Every non-trivial change passes the Team Change Gate.

changes: Added IContextFabricRepository and ContextEditLedgerEntry persistence contracts.
Added typed ContextConcurrencyConflictError for stale workspace writes.
Added MongoContextFabricRepository for context_workspaces and context_edit_ledger.
Made edit ledger insertion idempotent by editId.
Added Mongo indexes for durable context state.
Recorded the persistence boundary and indexed the decision under .okf.
Extended Context Fabric CI coverage to stacked feature branches.

verificationResults.note: Fresh PR-214 exact-head validation is required. Mongo live proof must remain UNPROVEN until a real Mongo instance verifies round-trip and concurrency behavior.
